chapters/ch4.1:
One weekend after the Sajik comeback.
Oppa wanted to go to the pay-to-fish pier again.
chapters/ch4.4:
At sunset, gripping his float rod tight,
Oppa suddenly got serious.
chapters/ch4.5:
Babe… thank you for always coming fishing with me.
For staying by my side all night, even with the mosquitoes…
chapters/ch4.7:
Right now… HERE?
Where it smells like bait??
chapters/ch4.8: Why did the ring come out from next to the WORM BUCKET!!!
chapters/ch4.9: Heesu's Menhera gauge is filling up…
chapters/ch4.13:
And so wedding prep began.
First hurdle: the wedding hall tour.
chapters/ch4.14: Oppa, how about this hall? High ceilings, nice and bright?
chapters/ch4.15: …Is it better than the last one?
chapters/ch4.16: Yeah! That one was good too!
chapters/ch4.17: Just then, quotes flew up from the consultation desk!
chapters/ch4.18:
Catering's extra~ Flowers are extra~
Weekend evenings have a surcharge~♪
chapters/ch4.19:
WHAT?????!!!!!!
That's not what you said at first!
chapters/ch4.20: I'm cutting every single extra fee.
chapters/ch4.21:
Next up: the dress tour.
Heesu tried on five whole dresses.
chapters/ch4.22: Oppa, how's this one? Compared to the last one!
chapters/ch4.23: …And this one? The silhouette's a bit different, right?
chapters/ch4.25: So which do you like better, the last one or this one?
chapters/ch4.27:
Oppa had turned into a Love-It Parrot
that only says "Love it"…
chapters/ch4.28:
…I'm asking you seriously right now.
Give me an actual opinion.
chapters/ch4.30: At that moment, the fitting room mannequins began to move!
chapters/ch4.31:
Say "Love it" one more time
and you're getting cleaned up along with the mannequins.
chapters/ch4.32:
Wedding photo shoot day.
Oppa had promised to lose 10 kg in three months.
chapters/ch4.35: Pop. A tuxedo button flew off.
chapters/ch4.37: A little late-night chicken… every day…
chapters/ch4.38: ……What did you do for three months?
chapters/ch4.39:
Photos last forever.
Oppa, hold your breath. Starting now.
chapters/ch4.41: Just then, the flash lights blazed and lunged at them!
chapters/ch4.42:
Photo selection day.
They have to pick album shots out of hundreds.
chapters/ch4.43: Oppa, which is better, this photo or this one?
chapters/ch4.46:
Oh hang on, just this round…
I'm in a boss fight…
chapters/ch4.48:
We're picking our WEDDING PHOTOS
and you're playing a game?!
chapters/ch4.49:
Just then, the Game Overlord
popped out of Oppa's phone!
chapters/ch4.50:
Kwahaha! This man's time belongs to ME now!
This selection room is my dungeon!
chapters/ch4.51:
Gacha capsules poured into the room.
The wedding photos on the monitors flickered.
chapters/ch4.52: B-babe… I'll quit… I'm quitting right now…
chapters/ch4.53:
Forget it. Until every photo is picked,
you're not going anywhere.
chapters/ch4.55:
The Game Overlord fell,
and every album photo was safely picked.
chapters/ch4.57:
Oppa, give me your phone.
I'm holding it today.
chapters/ch4.61: …Thanks for saying something other than "Love it."
chapters/ch4.62:
"Do you, the groom, promise to cherish
and love the bride for the rest of your life?"
chapters/ch4.63:
Ah, I mean! YES!!
I'll treat her right forever!!
chapters/ch4.66: And so Heesu and Oppa became husband and wife.
chapters/ch4.68: But babe… where are we going for the honeymoon…?
chapters/ch4.69:
I'm picking the honeymoon.
Anywhere except a fishing pier.
chapters/ch4.100: Love it~ love it~ love it so~♪
chapters/ch4.111: The ring box that came out next to the worm bucket. Fires sparkles
chapters/ch4.113: The dress that finally got "You're beautiful" instead of "Love it"
chapters/ch4.115: Put it in your hair and your mind feels neat too
chapters/ch4.117: For the aisle only. Also great for stepping on Oppa's foot
chapters/ch4.119: The thicker the envelope, the better the mood
chapters/ch4.121: In charge of ring delivery. The bow tie is the highlight
chapters/ch4.123: The cushion Bori carried down the aisle in his mouth. Ring's safe
chapters/ch4.141:
Weddings: 1 · "Love it"s: countless
{lv}

Heesu picks the honeymoon!
To be continued in Ch.5…
chapters/ch4.142: You marry once, but you prep for it again and again
